collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two children cheer for a pair of crabs scuttling toward the water.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two children cheer for a pair of crabs scuttling toward the water. One crab stops halfway to wave a claw, and the children decide it is showing off.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two children cheer for a pair of crabs scuttling toward the water. Both crabs reach the water at once, and the children call it a tie.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two children cheer for a pair of crabs scuttling toward the water. One crab turns around and walks the other way entirely.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two children cheer for a pair of crabs scuttling toward the water. The children decide the crabs both win and go looking for more.
